title: KIS's Server Difficulty Vote!
description: This is a datapack that allows you and your friends to vote to change the difficulty in a server, aslong as its installed on the server side. || Every Mod/Datapack I make is made by Claude I will not take any credit and I do not want to make any money
body: Disclaimer: All of my mods and modpacks are created with the assistance of Claude AI. I do not have a background in coding, but I create these projects because they either fill a gap that doesn't exist yet in the community, or because I wanted a more personalized version of something that already exists. Every project is made with genuine effort and a specific vision in mind. I do not and will not make any money from any of my mods or modpacks — they are completely free and will always stay that way. I hope you enjoy them.
